maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance brokerage commissions and fees on policy placements and employee benefits, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are private businesses, individuals and employers buying insurance and benefits; commissions come from commercial insurers and clients.

serial_acquirer.reason: Long-running strategy of buying middle-market insurance brokers, such as Poe & Associates and O'Leary Insurances in Ireland.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can switch brokers at renewal fairly easily; insurance is needed but the broker is replaceable.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call: insurance is essential, but changing broker is routine at renewal.
